summaries.title: Typhoon T1: An Open Thai Reasoning Model

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This paper shares the details about synthetic data generation and training, as well as our dataset and model weights。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We hope this open effort provides a foundation for further research in this field）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 16 赞，出自 Typhoon），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: CoT-Valve: Length-Compressible Chain-of-Thought Tuning
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **CoT-Valve** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)）。核心论点主张：We introduce a new tuning and inference strategy named CoT-Valve, designed to allow models to generate reasoning chains of varying lengths。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GSM8K, AIME**；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **32B**。实验设计与验证细节：We introduce a new tuning and inference strategy named CoT-Valve, designed to allow models to generate reasoning chains of varying lengths。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **95.07%, 94.92%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Moreover, we show that this property is valuable for compressing the reasoning chain；We applied this method to QwQ-32B-Preview, reducing reasoning chains on GSM8K from 741 to 225 tokens with a minor...）。
